summary: Reflected on the 2017 GitLab database deletion incident, connecting verified disaster recovery procedures and defensive systems design to production engineering.
evidence: Articulated the necessity of automated restore drills: proving that backups are actually restorable and establishing verified RPO/RTO guarantees rather than relying on unvalidated backup scripts.

Formulated Defense in Depth operational safeguards to protect against human error and late-night fatigue: least privilege credentials, soft deletes, deletion protection gates, and immutable snapshots.
